title: Transactions
fxRateHint: PLN per 1 {currency}. Empty = NBP rate on the trade date.
toAmountHint: Needed when the accounts use different currencies.
seriesHint: E.g. EDO1136: type plus month and year of maturity.
firstRateHint: Only needed for the first purchase of a series.
bondPriceHint: Usually PLN 100; PLN 99.90 when rolling over.
err_dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
err_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, e.g. 1,234.56.
err_quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
err_price: Enter a price greater than zero.
err_fee: The fee cannot be negative or larger than the sale value.
err_fxRate: The rate must be a number greater than zero.
err_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, e.g. USD.
err_transferTarget: Choose another active cash or investment account.
err_transferSame: The target account must differ from the source account.
err_transferAmount: The accounts use different currencies: enter the amount in the target account.
err_notFound: Account, transaction or instrument not found.
err_archived: The account is archived. Restore it to add transactions.
err_typeNotAllowed: This transaction cannot be added to this account.
err_insufficient: You cannot sell {requested} units: on {date} you hold {available}.
err_missingFx: No {currency} rate for {date}. Enter the rate manually.
err_deleteBreaksSale: Cannot delete: a later sale would exceed the holding ({available} units on {date}).
err_assetCurrency: The transaction currency must be the instrument currency.
err_bondSeries: Enter the series as TYPEMMYY (e.g. EDO1136) and the first-period rate.
err_negativeBalance: A liability balance cannot be negative.
err_manualName: Enter the instrument name (up to 120 characters).
err_generic: Could not save. Please try again.
